name: Speak with Belann

angles.text: As a Mage, making a personal spell focus marks a vital rite of passage and honors the ancient traditions of the High Order.

faq.answer: Belann Windwood is a master craftsman who lives in Valanaar. For more than a century, he has made staves and wands for members of the High Order.
The High Order is an ancient organization of practitioners. Its traditions include guiding young spellcasters as they make and master their own spell focuses.
A spell focus, such as a wand or staff, channels magical energies. For developing spellcasters in the High Order, making one is among the oldest rites of passage.
Valanaar is the settlement where Belann Windwood keeps his workshop and helps High Order students craft focuses.
As an aspiring wielder of magic, you are sent to study under Belann, whose expertise spans more than a century, and begin shaping your own magical implement.
faq.q: Why are you sent to speak with Belann?

faq.answer: When you introduce yourself to Belann in Valanaar, he welcomes you and prepares to explain the next stages of assembling your spell focus.
faq.q: What happens after you meet Belann?

sections.body: As students grow in command of magic, the High Order turns to an ancient custom to test and strengthen their talents. Making a spell focus of their own, whether a wand or staff, is one of the order’s most enduring traditions. It is for students who wish to bind their growing power to an implement they have made themselves.
sections.title: A Rite of Growing Power

sections.body: In Valanaar, initiates seek Belann Windwood for help with this craft. He has spent more than a century forging staves and wands for the High Order. A trusted mentor, Belann welcomes dedicated students and guides them through the craft and history of their magical tools.
sections.title: The Craftsman of Valanaar

summary: In Valanaar, aspiring spellcasters are sent to meet Belann Windwood. The High Order honors the making of a personal spell focus as a long-held tradition.
